8. [USER] The user decided to try out Ahrefs for keyword research.
9. [USER] The user asked whether to prioritize keywords with high search volume or lower competition.
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested prioritizing a balance between search volume and competition, recommending medium search volume with lower competition as the ideal scenario.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a guideline for keyword prioritization:
    - Search volume: 100-1,000 searches per month (medium to low)
    - Competition: KD (Keyword Difficulty) score of 30-60 (medium to low)
12. [USER] The user stated they would focus on keywords with medium search volume and lower competition to increase website traffic and drive more sales.
